integrity: All inequalities in the general-dimensional comparison are analytic. The exact-rational checker supplements rather than certifies the proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic consistent diagonal systems; fixed independent squared-norm probes; rejection of solved-row proposals; raw proposal counts, not accepted-iteration or CPU-time counts. No general nonorthogonal or adaptive sampling theorem.
title: A geometric-mean phase boundary for raw sampling cost in constrained Kaczmarz
